notes.title: Story Time - Patch V1.2.0
notes.content:
When listening to the feedback we've had so far, the thing that came up the most is players being annoyed at having to type in the same word multiple times in the same build. 

The words on their own are relaxing but there's not enough of them and they don't connect with what's on the screen.

So we went back to the drawing board. Each level now has a story based on what you're building. It's a different experience to read and type the story of someone travelling to London for the first time to see Big Ben or the peace that's experienced when gardening.

This is quite a big change to how the game feels to play and we really think it's a great addition.

Relax and enjoy,

Dave

tags.feature: Each level now has a story based on what you're building.

Relax and enjoy,

notes.title: Demo 1.0.5 Update
notes.content:
[h2]All Your Base[/h2]

Most of the levels now have a few pieces already laid to create a starting base. Part of the demo feedback was that initial empty levels could seem confusing and overwhelming. Having a base to build from, whilst still not giving the full structure away, should help. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44852654/e42f4d9fafc0dbbb135a5cc13ca0cf72f3e2c2ee.png[/img]

[h2]Button patterns[/h2]

Up to this point, button patterns were automatically created with a level editor. This had the benefit of being quick to create but some of the patterns, by nature, felt random and didn't always flow around the controller as a button pattern should. 

In this update, all patterns are human designed so that they all feel fun and punchy to input.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44852654/1fb5f975118453e51167562cdb23d1e10f535dbb.jpg[/img]

And that's not all. The classic saying, variety is the spice of controller based input, still rings true. Trigger patterns are now interspersed amongst the input stream to give your fingers a rest.

[h2]Level Groups[/h2]

The level select screen now has level groupings. In the demo these are 'Agriculture', 'Architecture' and 'Technology' but more will be added in time for early access. Our goal is to have 3 levels per group and as we get further in development, a group of levels would unlock together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44852654/fe5c55f30441703433f138f8fe5cc4d5f7c91f38.jpg[/img]

Enjoy and relax,

Dave

notes.title: Demo Language Update
notes.content:
The demo is now available in French, Italian, German and Spanish. Hopefully this should bring more stressed people to the store page who need a good relaxing. 

We're hopeful that the next language to be supported in the demo and store page will be simplified Chinese but this might need a little thinking about due to the large character set of that language.

It took some long nights combining ChatGPT and Google Translate to specifically find relaxing words in each language. This was the bit that we couldn't simply pay a translator to do without huge expense.

Enjoy and relax,

Dave
